settings.text:
Super Nintendo World is a fully immersive themed land at Universal Studios Japan, Universal Studios Hollywood, and Universal Orlando Resort (Universal Epic Universe). With thrilling rides, interactive games, themed dining, character meet & greets, and souvenir shops, stepping inside feels like entering the game itself. Every corner is designed to bring the magic of Mario and friends into your adventure.

settings.heading: Real Life Video Game Style Go-Karting - Japan

settings.text:
Live out your vide game dreams by racing through the streets of Tokyo or Osaka in a Go-Kart! Dress as your favourite character and zoom past famous landmarks in this exhilarating, one-of-a-kind adventure. It’s a thrilling way to see Japan while stepping straight into a storybook chapter of your own adventure.

The Nintendo Museum in Kyoto is the world’s first museum dedicated to Nintendo. Explore the history of this iconic company, enjoy interactive exhibits, and even play a variety of Mario games. It’s a must-visit for any Super Mario fan looking to dive deeper into the story behind the game.
